# Temple Scroll Column 62 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 62 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**62:1** If someone is discovered in any of the towns I am giving you — whether a man or a woman — doing what I consider evil,

**62:2** going off to worship other gods and bowing down to them, whether the sun, the moon, or any of the heavenly bodies,

**62:3** which I have never commanded, and word of it reaches you,

**62:4** you must investigate the matter thoroughly. If it turns out to be true beyond doubt — if such a detestable thing has actually been done in Israel —

**62:5** you must bring that man or woman who committed this crime to the town gate and stone them to death.

**62:6** No one may be executed on the word of only one witness; it takes two or three witnesses to impose the death penalty.

**62:7** The witnesses must throw the first stones, and then all the people must join in. In this way you will purge evil from among you.

**62:8** When a legal case is too complicated for you to settle — whether it involves a killing, a lawsuit, or an assault — any disputed matter in your towns —

**62:9** you must go up to the place I will choose and present the case to the Levitical priests and the judge serving at that time.

**62:10** Consult them, and they will hand down a ruling.

**62:11** You must follow their ruling exactly as they give it from the place I will choose. Be careful to carry out everything they direct you to do.

**62:12** Act according to the instruction they give and the decision they render. Do not deviate from their ruling in any direction.

**62:13** Anyone who arrogantly refuses to listen to the priest serving me there or to the judge must be put to death. You must purge such evil from Israel.

**62:14** When all the people hear about it, they will be afraid and will never act so arrogantly again.

**62:15** Suppose you hear a report about one of the towns I am giving you to live in:

**62:16** That corrupt and worthless men from among you have led the people of their town astray, saying: Let us go worship other gods you have never known —

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 62 merges laws about idolatrous individuals (Deut 17) with the apostate city (Deut 13). The column's force lies in God speaking these laws directly — no intermediary needed. "Corrupt and worthless men" expands בני בליעל to convey the full negative force of this Qumran term. The judicial appeal system points to the centralized authority the Temple Scroll envisions.*
